init_config_review.title: Set up computer use on this Mac

fields.label: Instructions
fields.description: Describe the task, or tell me in Chat when you start. For example: send an email using Gmail.

fields.label: Output folder
fields.description: Save the result and action audit here.

fields.label: Saved instructions
fields.description: Manage preferences and working rules in Chat > Memory. Applies to future runs.

starter_questions: How do I grant permissions to Computer Use?
Can you send an email using Gmail?
What do you remember from previous tasks?

setup_guide.introduction: Describe what you want done on this Mac. Computer Use has its own app for screen and input permissions. I will ask in Chat if you need to open an app, sign in, or resolve a blocker.

real.introduction: Use this Mac with an unlocked desktop. Grant Computer Use Accessibility and Screen Recording when prompted, then give a task.
